zhemn1cb.baseName: Walplus 1210 Branch Tips Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 210 cm
zhemn1cb.variantName: Walplus 1210 Branch Tips Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 210 cm
zhemn1cb.sourceDescription: Our white artificial Christmas tree forms the striking centrepiece of your Christmas decorations, creating a unique Christmas atmosphere! This beautiful Christmas tree, made of PVC material, is very lifelike in its shape and appearance. It has extra thick branches, which makes the tree seem even more realistic. All branches can be aligned which allows you to adjust the tree in the perfect form. The included metal stand provides your tree with optimal stability. The Christmas tree can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Additionally, It can be used both indoors and sheltered outdoors. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC, steel Total height: 210 cm Tree diameter: 110 cm With 1210 tips Extra thick branches Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

gm1wahz4.baseName: Christmas Tree World 12ft Pre-lit Ironwood Fir Tree
gm1wahz4.variantName: Christmas Tree World 12ft Pre-lit Ironwood Fir Tree
gm1wahz4.sourceDescription: The 12ft Ironwood Pre-Lit Christmas Tree features dense dark green PVC foliage with 4,700 branch tips and an overall diameter of approximately 200cm. Its heavy-duty construction incorporates 1,320 hand-strung warm white LED lights fitted to durable rubber cabling. Attached hinged branches allow the foliage to be assembled and shaped, while a folding metal stand with protective plastic feet provides support. The foliage has certified fire-retardant properties, and the tree is designed for indoor use only. Its stated height is measured from the floor, and accessories shown in product images are not included. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB
